definitions.explanation: The quality of being substantial and rewarding to read; depth and substance in written material.

examples.japanese: この{小説|しょうせつ}は{読|よ}み{応|ごた}えがある。
examples.english: This novel is a worthwhile read.

examples.japanese: {読|よ}み{応|ごた}えのある{記事|きじ}だった。
{内容|ないよう}が{濃|こ}くて{読|よ}み{応|ごた}え{十分|じゅうぶん}だ。
examples.english: The content is rich and very satisfying to read.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{読|よ}む (to read) + {応|こた}え (response/worth) → worth reading

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{読|よ}み{応|ごた}えがある (is worth reading, is substantial)
・{読|よ}み{応|ごた}えのある{本|ほん} (a book worth reading)
・{読|よ}み{応|ごた}え{十分|じゅうぶん} (fully satisfying read)

RELATED ～{応|ごた}え WORDS:
・{見応|みごた}え (worth seeing)
・{聞|き}き{応|ごた}え (worth listening to)
・{歯応|はごた}え (chewiness; challenge)
・{手応|てごた}え (response; feedback)

NUANCE:
Implies depth, substance, and satisfaction. Used positively for content that is engaging and rewarding rather than superficial.
